name: academic-students
description: Claude skills for university students in any degree and any country: break down and check assignments, split group work, estimate the grade an expert professor would give, academic writing with real citations, exam prep from past exams, lecture summaries, a study planner, read-only sync from Moodle (Canvas and Blackboard through the browser), right-to-left writing (Hebrew, Arabic, Persian, Urdu), and a prompt-injection scanner that checks every course file first. Never submits, never answers quizzes, never stores a password.
